CA.name: Yellow wild indigo
CA.citation: NatureServe Explorer; VASCAN; native range confirmed in southern Ontario. Species-specific form preferred over bare 'wild indigo', which risks conflation with the popular ornamental Baptisia australis (blue wild indigo)

DE.name: Wilder Indigo
DE.citation: Consistent name across many independent German sources including pharmaceutical manufacturer A.Vogel/Bioforce, Dr. Loges, Pflueger, and University of Ulm botanical garden; NatureServe corroborates real German commercial demand for this species specifically

FR.name: Indigo sauvage
FR.citation: Madaus, Lehrbuch der biologischen Heilmittel (via Henriette's Herbal Homepage)

US.name: Yellow wild indigo
US.citation: Missouri Botanical Garden Plant Finder; NC Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox. Distinguished from Baptisia australis (blue wild indigo) and true indigo (Indigofera tinctoria)
